E9-25 report: conditional claims at 0.9 against BEN defenders, not confirmed as registered

Where BEN 64 defends, committed lines failed 8 of 160 times with the scorer's weights and 5 of 165 with Gen 9's:
E9-24's direction, not distinguishable from no difference. (1) met on the point estimate only (ratio 1.65, 95%
interval 0.55 to 4.94); (2) not met (Fisher p 0.27, McNemar p 0.625); (3) not met (Gen 9 3.0% against the
house-defended control's 10.0%). Deviations: only the first Gen 8 BEN 64 feed family was read (no BEN 16 feeds
exist), and (2) is reported both ways. Results from transfer/gen9-e9-25-azure4-20261114 at c3033825.
